scientific.integrity: The stated boundary follows from an explicit averaged transition matrix, an exact characteristic-polynomial factorization, and the Jury criterion. The accompanying checker only verifies algebra numerically; it is not used as a substitute for proof.
limitations: The theorem concerns Schur stability of the first-moment state only.
The client model is scalar, two-point, equiprobable, common-minimizer, and uses exact proximal solves.
No mean-square, almost-sure, sample-path, or high-dimensional stability claim is made.

title: Exact first-moment stability frontier for two-client scalar SPAM
